notes.title: NEW GAME: The Wailer | AVAILABLE FREE NOW
notes.content:
Hello!

Vultive's latest game is out now for free on Steam! It is called 'The Wailer', and it is a highly stylized horror adventure game set in the depths of an ancient dungeon. 

We hope that you all enjoy this new game, it is the biggest one we have made so far!

- Ethan Robichaux
Vultive Entertainment

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2284260/The_Wailer/

notes.title: ALIGNMENT Hits 3000 Players!!!
notes.content:
[b]ALIGNMENT[/b] has just recently broken the [b]3000 player milestone![/b]

As this being my first fully published game, I am very happy and proud to see all the positive reviews of players' experiences on the game. I did not expect such a successful launch and I thank everyone who took the time to play and experience the game. These kind messages have motivated and inspired me to start work on a new game soon to be released. Once again thank you for all the valuable reviews and feedback!

[b]SPECIAL THANKS: [/b]
- To informative bug reports from players
- To User: "Most_Regrets" for creating a well produced step-by-step guide on how to complete all endings.

- Adam Robichaux
Lead Game Developer

notes.title: OUT NOW: Alignment
notes.content:
Vultive Entertainment's newest game Alignment is available now!

About Alignment:
[list]
[*]Alignment is a challenging and engaging puzzle game that will require you to move colored objects and place them on their respective platforms to explore through a series of increasingly complex levels
[*]It is also a game of discovering patterns, unraveling systems, and finding hidden meanings
[*]With an average playtime of 1 hour, this game will challenge your ability to piece together various systems as you progress
[*]You will also encounter different endings depending on your journey towards success. Can you uncover all 5 possible endings?
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2284900/Alignment/
